newReleases.name: Storm Born Kicker Bolt N Ball
newReleases.desc:
A mysterious accident changes everything. While driving through the city, our hero gets caught in a sudden crash. But instead of ending his journey, the accident awakens an incredible power within him the power of electricity!

Now, a simple ball is no longer just a ball. With every powerful kick, it can travel at lightning speed. Guided by a skilled trainer, master your new ability and prove that lightning can turn an ordinary kick into an unstoppable shot.

Swipe your finger across the screen to draw the perfect path for the ball. Aim carefully, control your direction, and let the player kick the ball with electrifying force. Score goals, overcome challenging obstacles, and use your lightning-powered kicks to complete each level on the road classes.

The journey takes place across dynamic city roads, where every level brings a new challenge. As you progress, the difficulty increases, demanding better aim, faster reactions, and smarter use of your special power.

newReleases.name: Super Bean Boy
newReleases.desc:
SWIPE TO FART
• Swipe up to fly, then steer through the gaps
• Blast-jump through blocked doors, even mid-flight
• Flick sideways to dash through walls
• Swipe down in mid-air for Toot-Time: the world slows to a crawl while you aim every toot

NINE BEANS, NINE POWERS
Every bean boosts your bending in its own way. Baked beans keep the gas coming. Butter beans shrug off explosions. Others give endless gas, toots that home in on their target, and more. Drink a potion mid-run and every special bean you eat fires at full power.

BOSSES, SKUNKS AND EXPLOSIONS
Take on Gary and his toilet drones, the bouncing Puppy Poopy and the bean-gobbling Bean Bin. Free the caged skunks before each boss, and once you have saved enough, call them in to fart alongside you. Set off TNT, nitro, blizzard and candy blasts all the way up.

PLANT YOUR FLAG
Every world belongs to whoever plants a flag on it, and their trail paints the ground everyone else climbs on. Climb past a rival's flag to take their world, then stand drones on your own to defend it.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Collect fart trails, from country flags to ones you draw yourself
• Pick a hat, and wear lucky pants to find more special beans
• Cook potions in your kitchen to level up your fart bending and your beans
• Come back for daily challenges and a 28-day streak

CLIMB THE BOARDS
Go furthest, collect the most gold, rescue the most skunks, keep your pants clean the longest, or race to 5K, 10K and the marathon.

newReleases.name: Glowpane: Logic Puzzle Game
newReleases.desc:
Light a stained-glass window, one piece at a time.

Glowpane is a calm logic puzzle with simple rules: place one piece in every row, every column and every colored zone of the board, and never let two pieces touch, not even at the corners. Every board has exactly one solution, and you can always reach it by logic alone. No guessing, ever.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Double tap a cell to place a piece. It’s checked right away.
• Tap once to mark a cross, a note for yourself. Drag your finger to cross off several cells in one stroke.
• A wrong piece costs a heart. You have three hearts per round.
• Stuck? From level 6 on, each round gives you three Hints and one Reveal. A Hint highlights the next logical step and tells you why it works. A Reveal places one correct piece.
• Your first board walks you through the rules, step by step.

WHAT’S INSIDE
• 100 levels in ten chapters, growing from 5×5 to 10×10.
• Each chapter is a stained-glass window: Ruby, Amber, Honey, Lime, Emerald, Turquoise, Azure, Sapphire, Amethyst and Fuchsia.
• From the third window on, every chapter ends with a hard board.
• Earn up to three stars on every level. A round with no mistakes earns all three.
• Each level you clear lights a petal of the chapter’s rose window. Three stars thread it with gold.
• When a board is solved, the glass replays your solve, piece by piece.
• Night scenes glow behind the board: a chapel at vespers, a moonlit library, a midnight nave, a cloister under the northern lights, a rose window at

newReleases.name: Goat Rodeo
newReleases.desc:
Goat Rodeo is a party game where you build the obstacle course together, then try to survive it.

Each round, everyone grabs an item from the box and puts it somewhere in the level: a plank to help, a spring to bounce, or a saw, a crossbow or a swinging wrecking ball to ruin a friend's day. Then everyone races from the start to the flag.

You score when you reach the flag and the others don't. Get there first for a bonus, or be the only one for a bigger one. Every friend your trap catches earns you points too. But if everyone makes it, the level was too easy and nobody scores. If nobody makes it, it was too hard. First to the target wins.

PLAY TOGETHER
• Pass it round: each person picks, places and runs on their own turn on one iPhone or iPad, racing the ghosts of the others, then you all watch the whole round replay at once
• One screen: two people sharing an iPad keyboard, plus bots
• Challenge a friend: reached the flag? Send the round as a link, and your friend races your run as a ghost on their own iPhone or iPad, then sends theirs back. Races are free on every level
• Bots fill the empty seats, in three moods: Chill, Normal and Wild
• Easy controls for small kids: hold an arrow and the goat runs that way, jumping by itself, and points the way when you go wrong. Fall in a pit and you're put back
• Interrupted? The match waits for you: close the game and carry on later
• Share the best moment: after each round, send a short video of the funniest catch to your friends

newReleases.name: GeoMasters
newReleases.desc:
GeoMasters is a collectible card game where every card is a real place: a hamlet, a village, a town or a megacity, with its real population, its photo and its stats. The bigger the place, the rarer the card.

YOUR HOMETOWN IS YOUR FIRST CARD
Pick your hometown, open your first packs and complete your collection area by area, on the map of each country.

FREE PACKS, PUBLIC ODDS
• A free 5-card pack every 10 minutes, plus a bonus pack when you log in each day.
• Seven rarity tiers, from Common to Mythic.
• The odds of every slot are shown before you open a pack. After a streak of packs without a Super rare or an Ultra rare, the next one is guaranteed to contain one.

OVER 95,000 REAL PLACES
More than 20 countries, from France to the United States and from Canada to the Middle East, plus a World pack to collect the countries of the globe. Population, area, elevation and biome come from public sources, credited in the game.

SIX WAYS TO PLAY
• Duel: a quiz on your cards against a bot, ranked against a player of your level, or with friends.
• Daily Commune: find the mystery place in 6 guesses from its outline, the same for every player in a country.
• Expedition: cross the country stage by stage, up to the final boss.
• Conquest: beat the capital of every region.
• Bluff: announce your cards' numbers, true or false, and catch the bot lying.
• Slot machine: free spins every day, matched against your collection, with no stakes at all.

BETTER WITH FRIENDS
• Add friends, message them

newReleases.name: Tiny Planet Run
newReleases.desc:
A tiny planet. A huge adventure.

Bloop is a long way from home. Guide this little explorer around colorful, spinning planets: dodge obstacles, leap over hazards and collect gems as each world brings a new surprise.

ONE THUMB, A WHOLE ADVENTURE
Steer around the planet, jump and roll your way through a run. Learn the rhythm of each world and find your own route through the obstacles.

30 WORLDS TO DISCOVER
Travel from green meadows and glowing lava to underwater worlds and outer space. Each world has its own scenery, obstacles and personality.

34 CHARACTERS TO COLLECT
Meet a colorful crew of runners, discover character cards and use the gems you earn to unlock more of the collection.

POWER UP YOUR RUN
A protective helmet, spring shoes, wings, a gem doubler, a magnet and a crown give you different ways to tackle the journey. Complete missions and earn gems for your next adventure.

ONE MORE TRY?
When an eligible run ends, you can choose to watch an available rewarded ad and continue from that point. This is optional and available at most once per run. Ad availability requires an internet connection and may vary.

Bring Bloop home, then see how far your next run can take you.

newReleases.name: Cats of the Garden
newReleases.desc:
Raise them. Train them. Send them into battle!

Cats of the Garden is a cozy cat-raising game with a tower-defense twist. Look after your cats like a real pet, train them to be brave, then place them around the garden to stop waves of bugs before they reach your house.

RAISE YOUR CATS
• Feed, groom, play with and pet your cats. They get hungry, bored, sleepy and messy over time, even while you're away
• Watch kittens grow into Young Cats, Grown Cats and Champions
• Keep them happy and healthy. Neglected cats get sick, but a little medicine and lots of love will put them right (cats never die!)

TRAIN THEM UP
• Build Strength for harder hits, Speed for faster attacks and Aim for longer reach
• Climb the cat tree, chase the laser pointer, scratch the post and more
• Happy cats learn faster

DEFEND THE GARDEN
• Place your trained cats beside the path and stop the bugs from reaching your house
• Battles get harder as you go, with new bugs, more waves and a boss every third stage
• Fight from morning sunshine to sunset to the middle of the night

COLLECT THEM ALL
• Adopt 8 different breeds, each born with its own talent
• Hunt for rare Shiny, Rainbow and Ghost cats
• Fill in your Book-O-Cats and keep extra cats in the Play Area

MAKE IT HOME
• Decorate with furniture, wallpaper and floors
• Unlock training gear that helps your cats learn faster

No ads. No accounts. No data collected. Just you and your cats.

newReleases.name: Vendy: Match & Sell
newReleases.desc:
Meet Vendy: a little vending machine on a world tour, and you're the one running her.

Stock pours in from the top. Match three or more of the same item and Vendy sells it out the bottom — every match is a sale, and every sale rings the till in whatever currency the country you're in uses. Clear the level's goal, keep her stock moving, and she ships on to the next stop.

WORLD TOUR
Travel Vendy through 196 countries, from sleepy villages to capital cities. Each stop restocks her with its own local treats, its own currency, and its own look — you'll know where you are within seconds of opening a level.

EVERY MATCH IS A SALE
This is match-3 reframed around commerce, not destruction: chain sales for bigger combos, watch the till fill up, and work through obstacles that block the shelves as you go.

BOOSTERS WHEN YOU NEED THEM
A shake, a swap, a bit of extra help on the stops that push back — boosters get you through the harder levels without changing how the puzzle works underneath.

TOKENS ARE OPTIONAL
Tokens are earned steadily just by playing, and you can top up with a purchase if you'd rather not wait — but nothing in Vendy requires spending money to keep going.

OPTIONAL VIDEO REWARDS, NEVER FORCED ADS
Vendy never interrupts your run with an ad. Now and then you can choose to watch a short video for a small in-game reward — always optional, and Retry is always free whether you watch one or not.

newReleases.name: Eremite
newReleases.desc:
If you ever looked at your RPG collection and wondered how awesome it would be to be able to play them without a group and game master, Eremite is the tool for you.
Eremite helps you play tabletop roleplaying games solo, keeping your oracle, dice, tables, maps, and journal in one place, ready at the table or on the couch.

In solo play you're both the player and the GM. Instead of having the story told to you by someone, you create it by asking questions to the Oracle, rolling on random tables and using the various tools Eremite provides you with.

Features:
PLAY
- Oracle: yes/no answers to your questions, weighted by how likely they are
- Dice roller: tap a die, or type any expression (like "2d6 + 1")
- Random tables: create your own tables, either simple one-dimensional ones, or composed from multiple tables
- Trackers: progress tracks, doom dice, a turn tracker, PbtA moves, and campaign notes

JOURNAL
- Every random table rolls, oracle answers and results of various tools are logged automatically
- Add your own entries: typed, handwritten with Apple Pencil (or your finger :)), or as voice memos you can transcribe
- Export your journal as Markdown with all contained images and audio

HEX MAPS
- Paint hand drawn OSR-style terrain
- Add notes to any hex
- Place and move tokens for your party, monsters, and various points of interest
- Make annotations or enhance your map with sketches using Apple Pencil
- Send a snapshot of the map to your journal

SKETCHING
- A freeform boar

- Faster table building: paste several tables at once or load them from a .txt file.
- Random Table Roll: type to filter your tables and find the one you need quickly
- Journal: New Entry, Quick Sketch and Record Entry now sit together under the + button.

newReleases.name: Corner A Politician
newReleases.desc:
They promised to address the issue. You brought a corner.

Welcome to Corner A Politician: a playful arcade chase through the Department of Evasive Answers. Your opponents are fictional politicians with important meetings to attend, committees to create and absolutely no intention of giving you a straight answer.

MOVE. ROTATE. CORNER.
Use two joysticks to move and rotate your solid walls. Herd a slippery politician into a closed pocket against the edge of the arena. V-shaped corners, square and rounded U shapes, and a deceptively simple straight bar keep the chase interesting.

PAPERWORK UNDER PRESSURE
Get close and watch a confident official turn into a sweating bundle of excuses. Expect frantic footsteps, comic panting, flying papers, spilled coffee and a suitably undignified reaction when the escape route disappears.

EIGHT COUNTRIES. ENDLESS EXCUSES.
Meet 32 fictional characters across Sweden, the United States, China, India, Russia, Germany, France and the United Kingdom. Hear political waffle in Swedish, English, Mandarin, Hindi, Russian, German and French, with optional English captions.

100 LEVELS OF INCREASING EVASIVENESS
The politicians get faster and harder to outsmart as your catching tool gets smaller. Each character keeps separate progress. Can you corner an entire career's worth of evasive answers?

TRY IT FREE
Play levels 1–10 with one character from each country. A single, one-time in-app purchase unlocks all 32 characters and all 100 levels per character.

newReleases.name: AI  Attack Arrows
newReleases.desc:
SOLVE. BUILD. ATTACK. DEFEND.

AI Attack Arrows combines satisfying arrow puzzles with a world of building, collecting and strategic attacks.

Every puzzle you solve earns rewards that make you stronger. Build your world, collect Attack Arrows and Shields, merge equipment into more powerful tiers, then take your arsenal into battle against other players.

SOLVE UNIQUE ARROW PUZZLES

Clear the board by finding the right order to release the arrows.

An arrow can only escape when its path is clear. One wrong choice can leave you blocked, so look ahead, find the sequence and clear every arrow from the board.

Choose your challenge with different puzzle sizes and difficulty levels. Bigger and harder puzzles offer greater rewards.

BUILD YOUR WORLD

Your rewards don't disappear when the puzzle ends.

Earn coins and use them to build and upgrade your world. Strengthen its items, increase its resilience and decide where to invest your rewards.

Unlock and collect different elemental worlds, each with its own identity, strengths and weaknesses.

COLLECT ATTACK ARROWS

Discover Attack Arrows while solving puzzles and build an arsenal for battle.

Your active world determines the elemental equipment you can discover, giving you new arrows to collect and strengthen.

Find duplicates? Merge matching arrows to create a more powerful version and prepare for tougher targets.

DEFEND WITH SHIELDS

Attack isn't everything.

Collect and merge Shields to strengthen your defences and protect you

newReleases.name: Amber 2048
newReleases.desc:
Amber 2048 is the 2048 you know, made quietly well. And it does not spy on you.

No account. No tracking. No analytics. No ads that follow you around the internet. Your game stays on your phone, where it belongs.

SWIPE, MERGE, 2048
Four tiles by four. Swipe and every tile slides as far as it goes; two equal tiles that meet become their sum. Reach 2048 to win, then keep going if you want to see how far the board will take you.

EVERY BOARD HAS A NUMBER
Board #617 here is board #617 on any phone, tile for tile, because the number decides the board. Look one up, replay it honestly, or hand a friend the number and compare what you each did with it.

THREE SIZES
Classic is four by four, with 2048 as the goal. Small is three by three, over in a couple of minutes, where 128 is the win. Large is five by five, a long game where 16384 is the one to reach. Each size keeps its own numbered boards and its own best score.

AND FIBONACCI
A fourth board plays by Fibonacci's rule: 1 and 2 make 3, 2 and 3 make 5, 3 and 5 make 8. Four by four, its own numbered boards, and 4181 is the win.

THE TABLE TURNS WITH THE SEASONS
Spring, summer, autumn and winter each bring their own colours to the table, following the calendar. Prefer one look all year? Choose Classic.

A BOARD A DAY
One Classic board a day, the same for everyone who plays it. Play it on its day and your streak grows; a day you skip is simply skipped, with no tricks to buy it back. A calendar fills in as you go, and three small goals
newReleases.coreLoop: Amber 2048 is the 2048 you know, made quietly well. And it does not spy on you.

newReleases.name: Angles: Fold & Tilt Puzzle
newReleases.desc:
How high does Tower Bridge lift? How far does Earth lean? How do you draw a star?

Angles is a puzzle you solve with your hands. Every level names an angle - you get the name, not the number. Work out how many degrees it is, then set it with your phone.

FOLD OR TILT
• On iPhone Duo, fold the hinge to the angle.
• On any other iPhone, tilt the phone: lying screen up is 0°, screen down is 180°.

FEEL YOUR WAY
Your phone ticks gently every 15° and harder at 90°, so you can feel the scale without looking - the rest is up to you. Land within 1° for three stars. You have about five seconds.

THREE WORLDS
• Geometry - a pencil-drawn notebook of shapes and angles
• Space - orbits, planets and tilted worlds
• Architecture - famous buildings on a 3D city map

IT'S ALL WRITTEN IN THE STARS
After every level you get a short fun fact about the angle you found - or the one you missed. Earn stars to open new worlds.

Geometry is free to play in full, with a first taste of Space and Architecture. Unlock the rest with a one-time purchase or a chapter bundle.

Made by one indie developer from Poland.

newReleases.name: Arrow Flow: Escape the Grid
newReleases.desc:
Small moves. A clearer mind.

Arrow Flow is a relaxing direction puzzle. Tap an arrow to send it out of the grid when its path is clear. Plan the order, open new paths, and clear every arrow.

KEEP YOUR FLOW
Play 1,000 fixed levels, then continue with newly generated puzzles. Your progress is saved on your device, and previously played levels remain available to revisit.

MAKE IT PERFECT
Finish with zero mistakes to earn Perfect. Use free hints, undo a move, or restart whenever you want. When replaying a level, continue to the next level or skip to the next one without a Perfect record.

FIND YOUR STYLE
Choose from eight visual themes with distinct arrow styles and effects. Enjoy responsive haptics, a sequence of twelve escape sounds, and a cheerful finish. Sound and haptics can be turned off separately.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
No countdown, no account required. Puzzles work offline. Choose from ten languages or follow your device language.

Arrow Flow is free to download and contains ads. An optional one-time purchase permanently removes all app-open, banner and interstitial ads. No subscription. Restore your purchase with the same Apple Account. Ads require an internet connection. Progress is stored locally; deleting the app removes your progress.

Play as Astro, a spacefaring cat armed with overwhelming firepower and a taste for catnip-fuelled destruction. Dodge relentless projectile storms, weave through laser grids, collapsing structures, fire traps, and floating islands, and blast everything standing between Astro and home.

Destroy enemies and collect temporary power-ups to build momentum, stacking your weapons into increasingly absurd combinations. The longer you survive, the more devastating you become—but miss an upgrade and the chaos will quickly catch up with you.

When everything aligns, unleash Astro’s ultimate catnip-powered attack: a spectacular anime-style finishing move and an instrument of pure feline fury.

Every level is a high-speed gauntlet packed with deadly hazards, bizarre enemies, and outrageous bosses. Face screen-filling mecha pandas, hyperactive huskies ripping open solar vortexes, opera-singing space squids, and celestial goldfish firing star-shaped projectiles.

Stay alive. Build your firepower. Reach the boss. Bring it down.

Astro Burn delivers fast-paced bullet-hell action with the colourful, anything-goes spirit of the arcade classics that inspired it.

You are the navigation app of a little city drawn as a graph: dots for corners, straight lines for roads. Every car wears the color of the stop it wants to reach, and its driver trusts you for one thing only: the shortest way there. Draw anything longer and the driver turns it down.

HOW TO PLAY
- Drag from a car to a stop of its color along the roads.

- Route every car before its patience runs out. You have three hearts per level.

WHAT YOU GET
- Endless logic puzzle levels: maps grow from a ring of 5 corners into a busy traffic city.
- A new city every 5 levels, each with its own shape and a hard finale.
- Crashes, roadworks, one-way roads, VIP cars, buses and second stops, one new idea at a time.
- Win streaks that help your next level: an extra heart, a free slow motion, calm drivers.
- Combos and tips, upgrades for patience, speed and tips, and daily rewards.
- Every color has its own symbol, so color-blind players can play too.

A calm brain teaser about shortest paths: no luck, just a sharper eye for the map with every level.

Free to play, with optional ads and in-app purchases.

newReleases.name: Cloword
newReleases.desc:
Cloword is a word game about the alphabet. A five-letter word is hidden somewhere in the dictionary, and you find it by closing in from both sides.

HOW IT PLAYS
Every guess must be a real word. It takes its place on the board: above the hidden word if it comes first in the alphabet, below it if it comes after, and it stays there as a new bound. The answer is always between the two bounds, and the window only ever closes.

Each bound tells you how many dictionary words still separate it from the answer. Counted in words, not letters, so the feedback stays sharp right to the last guess.

You have fifteen guesses a round.

WHAT HELPS
• The row you type in turns green for a real word inside the window, slate for a real word outside it, and red for something that isn't a word. You never learn anything about the answer without spending a guess.
• A letter tracker shows which letters the window still allows at the next position.
• A range strip shows where in the window the answer lies, once you have played a guess.

A REAL ENGLISH DICTIONARY
Thousands of five-letter English words, British and American spellings alike, with the answers drawn from the common ones.

NOT ONLY IN ENGLISH
Cloword plays in more than one language, each with its own dictionary. Switch whenever you like; the next word is in the new one.

ONE WORD A DAY IS FREE

updates.desc:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.

Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

updates.name: Food Hunt: Pixel Puzzle
updates.desc:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one h

all.name: Goat Rodeo
all.desc:
Goat Rodeo is a party game where you build the obstacle course together, then try to survive it.

Each round, everyone grabs an item from the box and puts it somewhere in the level: a plank to help, a spring to bounce, or a saw, a crossbow or a swinging wrecking ball to ruin a friend's day. Then everyone races from the start to the flag.

You score when you reach the flag and the others don't. Get there first for a bonus, or be the only one for a bigger one. Every friend your trap catches earns you points too. But if everyone makes it, the level was too easy and nobody scores. If nobody makes it, it was too hard. First to the target wins.

PLAY TOGETHER
• Pass it round: each person picks, places and runs on their own turn on one iPhone or iPad, racing the ghosts of the others, then you all watch the whole round replay at once
• One screen: two people sharing an iPad keyboard, plus bots
• Challenge a friend: reached the flag? Send the round as a link, and your friend races your run as a ghost on their own iPhone or iPad, then sends theirs back. Races are free on every level
• Bots fill the empty seats, in three moods: Chill, Normal and Wild
• Easy controls for small kids: hold an arrow and the goat runs that way, jumping by itself, and points the way when you go wrong. Fall in a pit and you're put back
• Interrupted? The match waits for you: close the game and carry on later
• Share the best moment: after each round, send a short video of the funniest catch to your friends

If you ever looked at your RPG collection and wondered how awesome it would be to be able to play them without a group and game master, Eremite is the tool for you.
Eremite helps you play tabletop roleplaying games solo, keeping your oracle, dice, tables, maps, and journal in one place, ready at the table or on the couch.

In solo play you're both the player and the GM. Instead of having the story told to you by someone, you create it by asking questions to the Oracle, rolling on random tables and using the various tools Eremite provides you with.

Features:
PLAY
- Oracle: yes/no answers to your questions, weighted by how likely they are
- Dice roller: tap a die, or type any expression (like "2d6 + 1")
- Random tables: create your own tables, either simple one-dimensional ones, or composed from multiple tables
- Trackers: progress tracks, doom dice, a turn tracker, PbtA moves, and campaign notes

JOURNAL
- Every random table rolls, oracle answers and results of various tools are logged automatically
- Add your own entries: typed, handwritten with Apple Pencil (or your finger :)), or as voice memos you can transcribe
- Export your journal as Markdown with all contained images and audio

HEX MAPS
- Paint hand drawn OSR-style terrain
- Add notes to any hex
- Place and move tokens for your party, monsters, and various points of interest
- Make annotations or enhance your map with sketches using Apple Pencil
- Send a snapshot of the map to your journal

SKETCHING
- A freeform boar

A fourth board plays by Fibonacci's rule: 1 and 2 make 3, 2 and 3 make 5, 3 and 5 make 8. Four by four, its own numbered boards, and 4181 is the win.

Angles is a puzzle you solve with your hands. Every level names an angle - you get the name, not the number. Work out how many degrees it is, then set it with your phone.

FOLD OR TILT
• On iPhone Duo, fold the hinge to the angle.
• On any other iPhone, tilt the phone: lying screen up is 0°, screen down is 180°.

FEEL YOUR WAY

THREE WORLDS
• Geometry - a pencil-drawn notebook of shapes and angles
• Space - orbits, planets and tilted worlds
• Architecture - famous buildings on a 3D city map

IT'S ALL WRITTEN IN THE STARS

all.name: BeTheNav
all.desc:
You are the navigation app of a little city drawn as a graph: dots for corners, straight lines for roads. Every car wears the color of the stop it wants to reach, and its driver trusts you for one thing only: the shortest way there. Draw anything longer and the driver turns it down.

HOW TO PLAY
- Drag from a car to a stop of its color along the roads.
- Only the shortest route counts. Cars can turn around, one-way roads cannot be driven backwards, and a crash can close a road under your routes.
- Route every car before its patience runs out. You have three hearts per level.

WHAT YOU GET
- Endless logic puzzle levels: maps grow from a ring of 5 corners into a busy traffic city.
- A new city every 5 levels, each with its own shape and a hard finale.
- Crashes, roadworks, one-way roads, VIP cars, buses and second stops, one new idea at a time.
- Win streaks that help your next level: an extra heart, a free slow motion, calm drivers.
- Combos and tips, upgrades for patience, speed and tips, and daily rewards.
- Every color has its own symbol, so color-blind players can play too.

A calm brain teaser about shortest paths: no luck, just a sharper eye for the map with every level.

Free to play, with optional ads and in-app purchases.

A pearl grows while the clam stays closed. Open it after a minute and you get sand. After an hour, a pearl. Leave it eight hours and the rare ones start turning up.

all.name: Cloword
all.desc:
Cloword is a word game about the alphabet. A five-letter word is hidden somewhere in the dictionary, and you find it by closing in from both sides.

HOW IT PLAYS
Every guess must be a real word. It takes its place on the board: above the hidden word if it comes first in the alphabet, below it if it comes after, and it stays there as a new bound. The answer is always between the two bounds, and the window only ever closes.

Each bound tells you how many dictionary words still separate it from the answer. Counted in words, not letters, so the feedback stays sharp right to the last guess.

You have fifteen guesses a round.

WHAT HELPS
• The row you type in turns green for a real word inside the window, slate for a real word outside it, and red for something that isn't a word. You never learn anything about the answer without spending a guess.
• A letter tracker shows which letters the window still allows at the next position.
• A range strip shows where in the window the answer lies, once you have played a guess.

A REAL ENGLISH DICTIONARY
Thousands of five-letter English words, British and American spellings alike, with the answers drawn from the common ones.

NOT ONLY IN ENGLISH
Cloword plays in more than one language, each with its own dictionary. Switch whenever you like; the next word is in the new one.

ONE WORD A DAY IS FREE
Play one word every day, for free, for ever. To play without a daily limit, unlock Cloword for a year, or once and for good, from inside the app. The

all.desc:
Yarn Loop is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game featuring colorful yarn bobbins and knitted patterns.

Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.
 
Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.

Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

Yarn Loop offers a smooth, calm, and visually charming journey through handcrafted yarn puzzles.

all.name: Pixel Flow!
all.seller: Loom Games Oyun Yazilim ve Pazarlama Anonim Sirketi
all.desc:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.
The conveyor has a capacity—push past the limit and you’ll need to wait. Send them in the right order, manage the flow, and hit the cubes to clear the board piece by piece. Simple mechanic, sticky loop: tap → flow → repeat.
Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one h
